explication: qs is a small JavaScript query-string library. Callers use its public API to parse strings into nested values or stringify values into query strings. Shared utilities support both directions, while formatters provide encoding-format choices. The graph focuses on runtime code; it does not imply that parsing and stringifying call each other.
